name: page-overview-purpose
goal: Page Overview begins with its short registered description above screenshots while the header stays concise.

evidence: Pages need one short purpose paragraph inside Overview above screenshot evidence. Keep the header concise, route details in Contract, and other tabs unchanged.

Existing entity overview and visual-overview scenarios only assert evidence placement and concise header copy. Strengthen their existing page cases to require the registered purpose before screenshots at current and selected commits across all three widths.
